items.body_excerpt: In New York tonight, Wizards coach Brian Keefe told reporters that Alex Sarr and Khris Middleton will not play tonight. Both are ramping up to game condition, but Sarr is getting close to playing soon. Tristan Vukčević (hip impingement) and Jamir Watkins (ACL recovery) are also out.

items.title: The Wizards' plan for Alex Sarr, who had surgery in mid-June to repair a fractured foot, has been for Sarr to hold off on contact drills during the first week of camp. It looks like Sarr will begin participating in full contact work very soon, perhaps as early as Monday.
items.author: Josh Robbins

items.title: I'm told the only players who did not participate in the Wizards' scrimmage today were Alex Sarr (who is set to ramp up to full contact in upcoming days), Tristan Vukčević (hip impingement) and Khris Middleton (ramping up/no injury).
